gifView.description: A GIF from the AppView's GIF provider (KLIPY), normalized to a provider-agnostic shape.

description.description: Provider content description of the GIF, suitable as default alt text.

gif.description: The full size animated GIF. Its url is the one embedded in posts.

preview.description: A still frame of the GIF, used as the external embed thumbnail.

tinyGif.description: A small animated GIF, suitable for picker grids.

mp4.description: An mp4 encoding of the GIF.

webm.description: A webm encoding of the GIF.

mediaFormat.description: A single encoding of a GIF.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.
